claim: The Transfer Family guide page on creating a server in a VPC says that only SFTP and FTPS can be used on an internet-facing VPC hosted endpoint (FTP is not among them). The Transfer Family FAQ adds that AS2 server endpoints support IP allow-list controls with security groups on internet-facing, VPC-hosted endpoints.

qualifiers.scope: Transfer Family internet-facing VPC hosted endpoint; SFTP, FTPS and FTP per the VPC server guide page, AS2 per the FAQ

evidence.quote: Only SFTP and FTPS can be used on an internet-facing VPC hosted endpoint.
Your AS2 server endpoints support configuring IP allow-list controls by using security groups with internet-facing, VPC-hosted endpoints.
